evidence: A furniture hobbyist says FreeCAD was more intuitive and faster with graphical tools than manually coding every detail in OpenSCAD, before later adopting an LLM-assisted OpenSCAD workflow.

evidence_sources.author: cladopa
evidence_sources.excerpt: I learned OpensCAD manually but it was so painful because you needed to take into account the most minimal and ridiculous thing using code, so I used Freecad in the end that is way more intuitive and fast with graphical tools.

source_story_title: Ask HN: CAD for wood working with LLM support?
